blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito has secured the commitment of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to remove infrastructure projects with incomplete documentary requirements from the proposed 2027 national budget. Ejercito, chair of the Senate Committee on Finance, met on Friday with newly appointed Public Works Secretary Giovanni Lopez and the latter’s predecessor, now Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon, to discuss budget concerns and ensure the continuation of DPWH reforms, particularly in the evaluation and approval of infrastructure projects. Following the meeting, Ejercito sent a formal letter to Lopez setting Nov. 3 as the deadline for the DPWH to […]...
